answer: Answer: CVE-2025-24514 (IngressNightmare) is a logical-authentication bypass and remote code execution flaw in Kubernetes Ingress-nginx controllers (versions ≤ 1.10.1) that arises from improper parsing of user-supplied `auth-url` parameters and TLS certificate common-name fields. The root cause is an Uncontrolled Data Type Conversion (CWE-843) in the Lua sandbox that coerces strings into table objects when the `auth-tls-verify-client` directive is enabled.
